lines.text: The Levites were brought to Jerusalem to celebrate the dedication of the wall with thanksgiving, singing, cymbals, harps, and lyres.
The priests and Levites purified themselves, and then they purified the people, the gates, and the wall.
Nehemiah appointed two thanksgiving choirs, and the first went toward the Dung Gate, led by Samuel the scribe.
Nehemiah followed the second choir with half the people, and both choirs stood in the house of God.
The priests, Levites, singers, and gatekeepers served as David and his son Absalom had prescribed.
